A hosted browser check is delivery proof, not user proof. Nobody outside the author has used this page. GATE-P2 is the instrument waiting for that, and it is a gate this package set itself rather than one the hackathon's rules ask for. simulated-panel-2026-09-03.json is a formative review by scripted reviewers, classified INFERENCE; it is not a user study, not learner validation, and not evidence of adoption.
